brainlife.readme:
mne.Epochs class: https://mne.tools/stable/generated/mne.Epochs.html
which contains Epochs extracted from a Raw MEEG data instance.
It is stored in a file named: `-epo.fif` or `-epo.fif.gz`

**Sharing:** Tier 2 (pseudonymised participant-level) by default.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/neuro.meeg.mne.epochs.json

files.desc: mne.Epochs class which contains Epochs extracted from a Raw MEEG data instance.

identifying_risks: MNE measurement info in the epochs FIF can carry subject_info, meas_date and digitised head points.
governance.rationale: Tool 1 step 6: participant-level M/EEG derivative linkable through a participant code.
sharing_cautions: Run mne anonymize (info) before sharing outside a controlled project.
tier_conditions: Tier 3 if the measurement info keeps subject_info (name, birth date) or meas_date.
